description:
PKIX-fmtv.11.1's bead description claimed 'bettertls.com hostname-matching corpus is already vendored in pkix-difftest' — that is not accurate. The workspace currently vendors only the bettertls::pathbuilding subset (in pkix-path-builder/tests/fixtures/bettertls/) and the bettertls::nameconstraints suite via x509-limbo. Neither is a hostname-matching corpus.

The upstream Netflix/bettertls project (https://github.com/Netflix/bettertls) ships a 'dnsnames' test suite that exercises RFC 6125 §6.4 SAN matching at scale (wildcard placement, IDN handling, IP-vs-DNS dispatch, etc.).

## Deliverable

- Vendor a subset of the bettertls 'dnsnames' corpus under pkix-difftest/ (or pkix-identity/tests/fixtures/bettertls-dnsnames/) following the existing extract.py + baseline.json pattern from pkix-path-builder/tests/fixtures/bettertls/.
- Add an integration test that walks the corpus and asserts pkix_identity::verify_dns_name's verdict against a baseline JSON file (regenerable via env-var-gated discover mode, same shape as pkix-path-builder's bettertls.rs).
- Document the upstream commit pin + extraction script in fixtures/README.md.

## Out of scope

- Hooking the corpus into the broader pkix-difftest 3-way diff (OpenSSL / pyca / pkix-path) — verify_dns_name is pkix-identity-only; oracle comparison would need a separate harness.
- bettertls's 'nameconstraints' suite — already covered by x509-limbo Tier-2.

## Why P3

PKIX-fmtv.11.1 shipped with 26 unit tests + 18 integration tests covering exact match / wildcard rules / IDN / IP / SAN-missing / mixed-case scenarios drawn directly from RFC 6125 §6.4 spec text. This bead is additional coverage, not a correctness gap. Filed because PKIX-fmtv.11.1 explicitly described bettertls integration as an acceptance criterion, and we didn't satisfy it in the original bead's scope (the corpus isn't vendored).
title: Wire bettertls dnsnames corpus through pkix-identity verify_dns_name
